about: Settings › Spotlight's Rebuild Index… (docs/adr/0051-search.mdx, decision 14) on the real search service, on a home the scenario makes, in English: the page follows the index's state (the service started at its first question, its first crawl told as it ends, never asked on a clock); Rebuild Index… asks first, and cancelled, the dialog goes and the page is as it was; confirmed, the service builds a new index from the files beside the one answering and puts it in its place, the page told as it goes and showing what the new index holds; every press Settings', exactly, and nothing else delivered.

steps.name: Spotlight, from the sidebar: Search Privacy… and Rebuild Index… under the results' switches
the index's state, followed: the first crawl told as it ends

texts: Spotlight reads your files again from the start. Until the new index is ready, searches use the current one. This can take a while.

steps.name: cancelled: the dialog goes, the index as it was
confirmed: the dialog goes and the service rebuilds
rebuilt: the new index answers, the page told what it holds, Rebuild Index… available again
